_comment: Provenance rows for scripts/lint/fixture_lint.py (fixtures/README.md). MINTED files need no row when a tests/fixtures/*_gen.cpp names them; a fixture a TEST regenerates (an opennova-produced self-capture, zero retail bytes) gets a 'minted_by' row naming that test and its flag. 'authored' is text we wrote; 'keep' is the retail-interop set kept byte-for-byte so the parsers prove they read what the shipped game wrote (ADR 0003). Size exceptions carry a why; nothing else may exceed 2 MiB.
